title: UAAP: La Salle outlasts UP in shootout, sets up Finals showdown vs. FEU
summary: De La Salle University is headed to the finals of the UAAP Season 89 women's football tournament after a thrilling victory against University of the Philippines, Friday at the Rizal Memorial Stadium.
